changeSet.author: finanzplaner
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial_plan ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, overdraft_limit TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE account ( plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_plan(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, opening_balance TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, position) ); CREATE TABLE entry ( plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_plan(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, recurrence_kind TEXT NOT NULL, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT, interval_every INTEGER, interval_unit TEXT, business_day TEXT, settled INTEGER, excluded_through TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, position) );
